backRaise.name: Back Raise (%)
backRaise.help: This setting raises the waist in the back. Our waist does not sit horizontally, but is angled up at the back. This setting allows you to raise this in the back if you need it for a good fit.

waistRaise.name: Waist Raise (%)
waistRaise.help: How much to raise the waist from the seat depth measurement. This influences the depth of the crotch cut-out.

fitWaist.name: Fit the garment to the waist
fitWaist.help: Traditionally, wrap pants are not fitted to the waist, and just use the flexibility of the fabric to adjust.

hemWidth.name: Hem size (%)
hemWidth.help: Size of the hem at the bottom of the pants

legSize.name: Leg Size (%)
legSize.help: This dictates how long the pants will be. It is a factor of the inseam measurement. The larger the value, the longer the pants.

waistOverlap.name: Waist Overlap (%)
waistOverlap.help: This dictates how much you want the leg flaps to overlap at the waist. A setting of 0 would have them meet at the side seam, and a setting of 100 makes them meet at the front/back.

frontPocket.name: Front pocket
frontPocket.help: Whether to include a front pocket or not

backPocket.name: Back pocket
backPocket.help: Whether to include a back pocket or not

frontPocketStyle.name: Front pocket style
frontPocketStyle.help: A welt pocket, or a pocket hidden in the waistband.

separateWaistband.name: Create a separate waistband
separateWaistband.help: Create a separate waistband, or have a hem the size of the waistband.

knotPlacement.name: Placement of the knot(s)

labels.traditional: Knot in the front and back

knotPlacement.help: The knot of the wrap straps can be placed in the front, back, or both front and back (traditional).

crotchFront.name: Crotch Front (%)
crotchFront.help: The percentage of the seat circumference that the front crotch needs to occupy. This creates more or less space between the side seam and the front.

crotchBack.name: Crotch Back (%)
crotchBack.help: The percentage of the seat circumference that the back crotch needs to occupy. This creates more or less space between the side seam and the back.

crotchFactorFrontHor.name: Front Crotch Factor Horizontal (%)
crotchFactorFrontHor.help: Used to move the curve of the crotch in the front horizontally

crotchFactorFrontVer.name: Front Crotch Factor Vertical (%)
crotchFactorFrontVer.help: Used to move the curve of the crotch in the front vertically

crotchFactorBackHor.name: Back Crotch Factor Horizontal (%)
crotchFactorBackHor.help: Used to move the curve of the crotch in the back horizontally

crotchFactorBackVer.name: Back Crotch Factor Vertical (%)
crotchFactorBackVer.help: Used to move the curve of the crotch in the back vertically
